In Technology & SaaS, cybersecurity & zero-trust covers architecture-level security programs: zero-trust network and workload design, identity modernization, threat intelligence and managed detection, cloud posture management, ai-specific security for models and agents, cyber resilience, and the compliance machinery (soc 2, iso 27001, pci dss, dora) that regulated industries must evidence. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: zero-trust architecture & implementation, threat intelligence & managed soc, identity & access modernization — delivered on Tele Medicine Platform and Driisti Smart Vision Glasses with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: SOC 2/ISO 27001 evidence assembled manually per audit; security questionnaires consume engineering weeks per quarter.
Deploy frequency rises while incident load eats roadmap; error budgets exist in slide decks, not in release policy.
Teams bolt on LLM features with no cost telemetry, no eval harness and no guardrails; margins erode silently per customer.
